title: Evaluate Roc as game designer language with Baize platform
description: Roc (roc-lang.org) is a pure functional language with a platform/embedding model, WASM target, no runtime exceptions, and designed for non-academics. Evaluate whether a Baize-specific Roc platform can provide board query primitives (zone, adjacent, flood_fill, connected_components, path_exists) as platform functions, letting game designers write pure Roc scoring/validation logic that compiles to WASM matching our WasmHost ABI. Spike: write a minimal Roc platform that exposes game state, implement poker hand scoring in Roc, compile to WASM, load via WasmHost. If viable, this avoids building a compiler from scratch.
notes: Alternative to Felt (baize-l8ai). Decide between Roc and Felt based on spike results.
close_reason: Decision: Felt wins. Roc evaluation dropped.
